maria_cs: Heads-up — Vega Labs dedicated bring-up is tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final quorum: quota, autoscale targets, and a 1-page ops checklist. Who can own traffic profile + warmup?

jamie_se: I got the traffic profile. Will produce a short script that exercises cold vs warm cache and a 10m spike.

liam_ops: I'll take autoscale rules. Quick ask: what guarantees did they buy?

maria_cs: 32-GPU reserved, target p95 <= 180ms, baseline 250 qps, burst to 400 qps for 10m. Renewal check: they flagged latency in previous pilot as a risk.

jamie_se: Plan outline: 1) Health probes, 2) Cold priming 10m @ 40 qps, 3) Warm sweep 5m @ 140 qps with KV priming, 4) Spike 10m @ 360 qps, 5) Soak 20m @ 220 qps. Will add simple curl-based validations.

liam_ops: Autoscale knobs: min pods=4, max=14. Scale up if GPU mem >70% OR queue length > 60 for 45s. Scale down if mem<45% for 5m. Add automated fallback to quantized variant if p95>300ms for 2m.

neal_poc: Vega SRE here — can you confirm warmup will run prefix priming (we saw large token latency on first hits)?

jamie_se: Yes, will run prefix set. Example loadgen: `loadgen --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate --qps 140 --dur 300 --model vega-served-v1 --seed warm_prefixes.txt`

maria_cs: Also need quota smoke to ensure throttles won't cut the bake. Liam?

liam_ops: Affirmative. I'll run a quick quota check + post results at 08:30 PT. Script: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/v1/health` then 5 concurrent gens.

k8s-bot: Deployment redwood/vega v2026-03-22 promoted to staging — CI: https://ci.redwood/build/vega/4521 :rocket:

jamie_se: Suggest pinning canary variant to `vega-q8-canary` for the spike to validate fallback route. Canary policy: 10% -> 30% if stable.

liam_ops: I'll create alert: p95 >220ms for 3m and a burn-rate alert for GPU queue >80.

maria_cs: I'll draft the 1-page ops checklist (health endpoints, dashboards to watch, rollback steps, contacts) and post by EOD. Final test window 09:00-10:15 PT, no changes after 10:00.

neal_poc: Thanks — we'll join the window. Please post final runbook link here.

jamie_se: Runbook draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood/vega/onboard-runbook (internal). Includes scripts and validation steps.

liam_ops: Quota smoke done; no unexpected throttles. Logs in the runbook. Infra green.

neal_poc: All good from Vega side. See you at 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
